about: The newest Apache Tomcat release on each supported line. Each one fixes every Tomcat bug we cover, except the two cluster bugs listed below.
older: Tomcat 8.5 reached end of life on 31 Mar 2024 and gets no fixes; 10.0 and older are also unsupported. Spring Boot embeds Tomcat and pins its own version.
